issues: Cited Wikipedia (Bernstein v. United States) for the withdrawal of the 1999 panel opinion. Replaced with the Ninth Circuit's order itself, Bernstein v. U.S. Dept. of Justice, 192 F.3d 1308 (9th Cir. 30 Sept. 1999), in the Harvard Law School Caselaw Access Project's copy of the reporter.

sourceFixes.institution: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit (order; text via Harvard Law School Library, Caselaw Access Project)
sourceFixes.title: Bernstein v. United States Department of Justice, No. 97-16686, 192 F.3d 1308 (9th Cir. 1999) (order granting rehearing en banc)
sourceFixes.quote: Upon the vote of a majority of nonre-cused regular active judges of this court, it is ordered that this case be reheard by the en banc court pursuant to Circuit Rule 35-3. The three-judge panel opinion, Bernstein v. U.S. Dept. of Justice, 176 F.3d 1132 (9th Cir.1999), is withdrawn.
sourceFixes.note: Replaces a Wikipedia citation. Checked with fetch-text --check: FOUND. The hyphen in 'nonre-cused' is in the reporter text. The order is signed by Chief Judge Hug and dated Sept. 30, 1999. CAP metadata gives decision_date 1999-09-30 and cites_to 176 F.3d 1132 (the 6 May 1999 panel opinion). CourtListener carries the same text but returned an empty 202 challenge to scripts.
